title: NAZAR draft evidence-chain envelope
description: Draft record/envelope only. No signature field or claim of provenance is defined here; canonicalization and signature rules must be frozen before cross-device use.

record_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical envelope body excluding record_hash; see docs/evidence-format.md.

room_id.description: Use a non-identifying session/room token; do not store a precise address.

flow_id.description: Session-scoped identifier; not a persistent hardware address.

statistical_result.description: Exact metric/field semantics are to be frozen with the Finale detector.

second_round.description: Second fresh challenge outcome and its stimulus reference; exact semantics are to be frozen.

optical_candidates.description: Candidate summaries only; avoid embedding room video or unnecessary images.

region.description: Approximate region and uncertainty, not a centimeter-level location.

coverage.description: What was inspected and what remains uncertain/untested.

model_hash.description: Null if no model was used; a hash is not evidence of model validity.

device_metadata.description: Minimum device metadata needed to reproduce/interpret the run; avoid personal identifiers.
